profile.name: Sunpower CryoTel GT低温制冷机
profile.description: 这是一款用于低温实验的机械式低温制冷机，可为样品台、探测器或其他低温部件提供冷量。实验中通常用它来读取当前温度、设置目标温度或功率，并查看制冷机的运行状态与告警信息。
profile.description_en: This is a mechanical cryocooler used in low-temperature laboratory experiments to provide cooling for sample stages, detectors, or other cryogenic components. It is typically used to read the current temperature, set a target temperature or power, and monitor operating status and fault conditions.
